scope: Elementary prepared-substrate strand transfer, not kit activation preparation or host repair

sources.title: pcDNA3.1 Directional TOPO Expression Kit, Version F, 10 November 2010
sources.location: printed page 2 / PDF page 12: phosphotyrosyl mechanism and directional displaced-flap diagram
sources.evidence: Diagram preserves displaced insert-bottom3prime four-nucleotide flap. Displayed bottom GTGG runs3prime to5prime; actual5prime to3prime sequence is GGTG.

sources.title: Cheng and Shuman 2000, DNA strand transfer catalyzed by vaccinia topoisomerase: ligation of DNAs containing a3prime mononucleotide overhang
sources.evidence: Prepared CCCTT donor3primeT overhang transfers to acceptor5primeOH with3primeA overhang. Opposite strand remains nicked; mismatch transfer occurs under some experimental conditions, not predicted here.

sources.title: Shuman 1994, Novel approach to molecular cloning and polynucleotide synthesis using vaccinia DNA topoisomerase
sources.evidence: Prepared phosphotyrosyl complexes and complementary acceptor geometry; original free5primeOH can reverse the enzyme-DNA linkage.
Vaccinia enzyme recognition(Y)CCTT and3prime-phosphate adduct, not ordinary DNA ligase.
PCR5primephosphate inhibits TOPO transfer; vector terminal chemistry includes activated3primephosphate and5primephosphate.

extensions: Complete four-nucleotide opposite-strand displacement and displacement with unpaired continuation are declared physical graph branches. They are not empirical commercial-kit or efficiency claims.
